limitations: A repeated trajectory is compared with original aggregate diagnostics; original later particle states were not preserved.
Direct energy evaluation is CPU Float64 of actual stored GPU particles, not Float64 integration.
Only selected epochs are directly audited; maxima are sampled.
Exact equality of original K and U at selected epochs does not constitute a bitwise comparison of unavailable original particle states.
Eight directly audited epochs do not bound energy excursions between samples.
This repeat does not isolate the residual into KDK truncation and GPU Float32 force/accumulation roundoff.
